title: CLEARink ePaper 2.0 at SID Display Week 2019
summary: Charbax interviews the CEO and CMO of CLEARink at SID Display Week 2019 about their eTIR reflective display technology. It demos 9.7-inch low-power color and video ePaper with high refresh capability.
why: Cited by e-ink enthusiasts as the main look at CLEARink, a hoped-for next-generation reflective display startup.

quote.text: their tech does look quite impressive[0]!
